title: OpenAI Acquires Presentation Startup NextSlide, Team Will Join ChatGPT Development
excerpt: OpenAI recently announced the acquisition of the presentation startup NextSlide, with team members joining OpenAI and participating in the development of ChatGP
content_html:
OpenAI recently announced the acquisition of the presentation startup NextSlide, with team members joining OpenAI and participating in the development of ChatGPT-related products. The financial terms of the transaction have not been disclosed. According to Ahmed Beshry, the founder of NextSlide, the acquisition actually took place earlier this year, which is why the related news was delayed for several months.

NextSlide previously focused on AI-powered presentation generation, with its products capable of converting prompts, notes, documents, or research findings into editable presentations. Beshry said the company's goal was to make visual communication more convenient, helping more people express their ideas clearly. After joining OpenAI, the team will continue in this direction, developing AI products that help users create, communicate, and turn ideas into real results.

This acquisition further reflects OpenAI's product strategy of expanding into productivity and content creation scenarios. As generative AI gradually moves from text-based Q&A to office tasks such as documents and presentations, AI assisting in the complete creative process is becoming an important application direction.

Beshry previously also served as co-founder of Caper AI, a startup specializing in smart shopping carts and unmanned checkout technology, which was acquired by Instacart for $350 million in 2021.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 近日宣布收购演示初创公司 NextSlide，团队成员加入 OpenAI，参与 ChatGPT 相关产品的开发。 交易的财务条款尚未披露。 据NextSlide创始人Ahmed Beshry透露，此次收购实际上是在今年早些时候进行的，这也是相关消息延迟了几个月的原因。

NextSlide 之前专注于人工智能驱动的演示文稿生成，其产品能够将提示、笔记、文档或研究结果转换为可编辑的演示文稿。 贝什里表示，公司的目标是让视觉交流更加便捷，帮助更多人清晰地表达自己的想法。 加入OpenAI后，团队将继续朝这个方向发展，开发帮助用户创造、交流并将想法转化为实际结果的AI产品。

此次收购进一步体现了OpenAI向生产力和内容创作场景拓展的产品策略。 随着生成式AI逐渐从基于文本的问答转向文档、演示等办公任务，AI辅助完整的创作过程正在成为一个重要的应用方向。

Beshry 此前还曾担任 Caper AI 的联合创始人，这是一家专注于智能购物车和无人结账技术的初创公司，该公司于 2021 年被 Instacart 以 3.5 亿美元收购。
